#### Domain depth that survives scrutiny
A decade in financial services means I know what regulators, customers, and operators actually care about. Models that decide credit, analytics that allocate capital, systems built under real constraint.
:::

::: {.differentiator-item}
::: {.differentiator-number}

#### AI-native execution as a leverage multiplier
I use AI as core leverage for research, synthesis, prototyping, and shipping — not as a tool I'm interested in. It expands the surface area of what one operator can deliver.
:::

::: {.differentiator-item}

03

Most AI-native operators don't have the domain depth. Most domain experts haven't rebuilt their workflows around AI. The intersection is where I work.
:::
